Questions

Is it a subscription?

No. You pay once and keep it, with free updates.

How do I activate my key?

Right after checkout, click "Open in Burnfeed" and the app activates itself. Your key is also in the receipt email from Dodo Payments; paste it into the License tab of the Burnfeed app.

How does Burnfeed Team work?

You get one key. Share it with up to four other people; each of you activates it on up to two Macs, ten Macs in all.

I got a new Mac.

On the old Mac, open the License tab of the Burnfeed app and choose "Deactivate this Mac", then enter your key on the new one. If the old Mac is gone, email us and we'll free the seat.

Can I get a refund?

Yes, within 14 days, no questions asked: email mail@warplabs.co from the address you bought with.

Does it work on iPhone or iPad?

No, Burnfeed is for Safari on Mac.

Sold by Priyam Ventures Private Limited. Dodo Payments is the merchant of record: they take the payment, handle tax and email your receipt with your license key. Prices may show in your currency at checkout, plus local tax where it applies.
